chapter: Chords, recordings and his own groups
title: Producers choose the sidemen
summary: Producers pick musicians who do not mix, then blame the leader when records fail.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: fellas that don't mix. . . . Not that they can't play they just don't mix. And they would do that type of thing and it didn't come out right. And they produce and then . . . if the record didn't sell, then they blame it on you, when he did all the pickin' and the songs and everything.
. . . . Prestige would hire sidemen for me, a lot of them did it . . . . I guess they was lookin' for names, you know.
